items.title: Bat Tasting a Strawberry
items.alt: A seated friendly bat holds a single large strawberry between its two wing thumb hooks, wings folded into clear elbow-like bends without extra arms.
items.description: A seated friendly bat holds a single large strawberry between its two wing thumb hooks, wings folded into clear elbow-like bends without extra arms. Useful for fruit vocabulary cards.
